reviews.text: Great staff who take good care of both animals and owners, take the time to listen and do a brilliant job with treatment❤️
Took my cat Lars here for his final goodbye, and the vet who attended was gentle, supportive and helped us through this extremely difficult time. Very professionally handled.
Very good experience visiting Petrus at Gressbanen! Veterinarian Marianne is so skilled and calm. We will definitely be back😊 …
Don't understand why there is a need to provide your personal identification number?

Easy to book an appointment online, got an appointment the same day.
Was met by a skilled and clear veterinarian, recommended!
Nice and friendly veterinarians at Gressbanen! Good information and feedback. Easy to park.

We are incredibly happy with Petrus Gressbane! ❤️

We brought Ludde (our cat) in for castration and had a great experience. We got an appointment very quickly, the communication was great, and the whole process went efficiently and smoothly.

The staff appeared to be skilled, professional, and caring, and we felt that Ludde was in very safe hands. In addition, we think the price was very nice – especially considering the good service and follow-up.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of Ludde! 🐾❤️

Hello.
I was with you today with my dog, Lucas. I would like to say that we are very satisfied with the visit.
The vet was very friendly, caring and professional. She treated Lucas in a very calm and safe way, and gave us good help and a thorough assessment.
I also felt very well taken care of as an owner, and the communication was very nice and respectful.
We would like to come back to this clinic in the future, and it would be nice if it is possible to get an appointment with the same vet again, since Lucas was very comfortable with her.
Thank you very much for your help
Nice and new clinic, and Marianne is a super vet. Recommended!☺️
Very good prices, skilled, easy service and free parking.
